case.t0_rule: WHO declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (docs/DAC_PPE_CODING.md §2)
case.response_scale: Swedish national government and its agencies (Socialstyrelsen, MSB); regions, municipalities, SKR and Adda are context
case.start_rule: First national purchase order or contract for PPE for general supply; inquiries, offers and EU joint procurement excluded

inclusion_rules.firm_order: First national purchase of PPE for general supply
inclusion_rules.binding_act: First legally binding national act concerning the PPE response
inclusion_rules.dedicated_funding: First funding legally earmarked for PPE
inclusion_rules.delivery: First physical delivery of nationally procured PPE to regions and municipalities
inclusion_rules.institutionalisation: First permanent body created for the hazard

observation_window.reason: First wave; opens 1 Jan so that pre-t0 events can be context (docs/DAC_PPE_CODING.md §5)

not_accessed: Socialstyrelsen's answers to the Corona Commission and other documents cited by the SOU
SOU 2020:80 (first interim report, cited for February-March details)

case.identification: Not testable: no delivery is linked by the source to a specific order.

events.description: WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (not in the Swedish source's PPE chapter; cited from the Belgian chronology, rule §5 Germany a)
events.source: Chambre, Commission spéciale COVID-19, DOC 55 1394/002 (2021), Annexe 5, PDF p. 342, row 36 (CRIV K001, De Raedt)

events.description: Socialstyrelsen alerts MSB to a possible shortage of protective equipment
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 322

events.description: MSB's national situation report urges the regions to secure purchase and distribution of PPE
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 322

events.description: Socialstyrelsen makes minor purchases of protective equipment in February 2020 (first national purchase; rule §5 Sweden a)
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 371, p. 336 and p. 34
events.source_wording: 'gjorde smärre inköp av skyddsutrustning i februari' (p. 371); 'gjordes inköp av skyddsutrustning redan från februari 2020' (p. 336)

events.description: All regions assured at a coordination meeting that Socialstyrelsen is active on the market to secure purchases for Sweden
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 325

events.description: Region Stockholm, Västra Götalandsregionen and Region Skåne petition the government for national decisions to secure supply
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 324

events.description: Government assigns Socialstyrelsen to secure access to protective equipment and coordinate purchases (rule §5 Sweden d)
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 325

events.description: Government decides förordning (2020:126) on distribution of medical supplies: Socialstyrelsen may order a region or municipality to hand over PPE to others
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 326

events.description: First deliveries of protective equipment from Socialstyrelsen to regions and municipalities: March 2020 bar of Figure 8.2, about 1.07 million items, all PPE (decomposed by scripts/se_figure82_march.py; rule §5 Sweden b)
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 338, Figure 8.2
events.source_wording: 'Fördelad skyddsutrustning och provtagningsutrustning per månad, som komplement i regioner och kommuner, mars 2020 till mars 2021' (Figure 8.2, bar 2020-mar)

events.description: Government crisis office memo: material received by Socialstyrelsen is distributed 'till verksamheter' after checks (recipient level not stated; rule §5 Sweden c)
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 334

events.description: Government temporarily waives the CE-marking requirement for certain PPE
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 329

events.description: SKR assigns its purchasing centre Adda to buy material for municipalities (not national government)
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 329

events.description: Adda starts delivering material to municipalities via its web shop (SKR, not national government)
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 330

events.description: State grants for pandemic extra costs (förordning 2020:193), covering PPE together with personnel, transport and other equipment; not earmarked for the PPE response (rule §5 Sweden e)
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), PDF p. 334

events.description: No funding legally earmarked for the PPE response found (the state grants cover several cost types, rule §5 Sweden e)
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), chapter 8 searched in full

events.description: No permanent body for the hazard described in the window (rule §5 Sweden f)
events.source: SOU 2021:89, Sverige under pandemin, volym 1 (Coronakommissionen), chapter 8 searched in full
